faqs.a: TarVance is a software company based in Kolkata. We build custom software and business websites, set up and optimise Google Business Profiles, and handle SEO and ongoing maintenance.

faqs.q: Do you build websites and software for businesses in Kolkata?
faqs.a: Yes. Our office is on Manicktala Main Road in Kolkata, and we work with local businesses such as clinics, gyms, cafés, salons and shops, in person or remotely.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses in Maharashtra, Mumbai and Pune?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with clients across Maharashtra, including Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur, remotely by phone, WhatsApp and video call. Everything is agreed in writing, so distance doesn't get in the way.

faqs.q: How much does a website or custom software cost?
faqs.a: It depends on what you need. After a first conversation we send a written scope, timeline and price, so you know what you're paying for before any work begins.

faqs.q: Can you help my business show up on Google Maps?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up and optimise your Google Business Profile with the right details, photos and hours, and combine it with local SEO on your website.

faqs.q: Do you provide support after the website or software goes live?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer maintenance and support for updates, fixes and small changes, and keep your website, software and Google profile accurate and secure.

faqs.q: How do I get started with TarVance?
faqs.a: Call or WhatsApp us on +91 82820 17341, email contact@tarvance.com, or use the form on our contact page. A rough idea is enough to begin.

Because our office is in Kolkata, we can meet in person at the start of a project, or work over phone, WhatsApp and video call if that is easier for you.

sections.h2: Get found on Google in Kolkata
body: When someone nearby searches for what you do, your Google Business Profile and your website both matter. We set up your profile with the right details, photos and hours, and structure your website pages so Google understands what you offer and where.
That combination of local SEO, a fast mobile-friendly website and an accurate Google profile is the practical way for a Kolkata business to show up in Search and Maps.

We start with a conversation about your business, then send a written scope, timeline and price. You see the design before we build, we share regular updates, and we stay available for fixes and changes after launch.
